question: The Padma Shri awardee (2016) Gulabo Sapera is known as the Queen of __________ dance.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kalbeliya**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Gulabo Sapera** is a renowned dancer who was awarded the Padma Shri in 2016.
 
• She is famously known as the Queen of **Kalbeliya** dance, which is a traditional folk dance of Rajasthan.
 
• The Kalbeliya dance is performed by the Kalbeliya community, known for their traditional occupation of snake charming.
 
• This dance form is characterized by intricate movements and vibrant costumes, often resembling the movements of a serpent.
 
• Kalbeliya dance has been recognized by UNESCO as an Intangible Cultural Heritage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Kalbeliya community** is traditionally known for their expertise in handling snakes and their knowledge of herbal remedies for snake bites.
 
• Over time, as snake charming became less viable due to legal restrictions, the community shifted towards performing their traditional dance to sustain their livelihood.
 
• The dance is an integral part of the community's social and cultural fabric, often performed during festivals and celebrations.
 
• Gulabo Sapera has played a pivotal role in popularizing the Kalbeliya dance both in India and internationally.
 
• Her contribution to preserving and promoting this cultural heritage has been widely acknowledged.
